slot_scores.name: project1_investment_timing
slot_scores.evidence_quote: For project (1), can you invest in it at the beginning of any of the three years (i.e., it is available in years 1, 2, and 3), or is it restricted to a specific year?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether project (1) can be invested at the beginning of any of the three years, directly covering the hidden timing flexibility.

slot_scores.name: project1_reinvestment_rule
slot_scores.evidence_quote: For project (1), is the 20% annual profit paid at the end of each year while the principal stays invested (so it can be reinvested in later years), or is the principal returned only at the end of the third year?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked whether project (1) principal and profit can be reinvested in later years, covering the reinvestment rule.

slot_scores.name: project2_recovery_timing
slot_scores.evidence_quote: For project (2), is the 150% total return paid as a single lump sum at the end of the third year (i.e., you invest at the start of year 1 and receive 1.5 times the investment at the end of year 3)?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent probed the recovery timing of project (2), and the user corrected it to end of year 2, resolving the slot.

slot_scores.name: project3_investment_timing

slot_scores.name: project4_investment_timing
slot_scores.evidence_quote: For project (4), at which point in time can you invest in it, and is the 40% profit paid at the end of the third year together with the principal?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked when project (4) can be invested, and the user confirmed beginning of the third year.
